description: Static onboarding guide for connecting local LLMs to MMIR.ai through the hardened MMIR Local Node.

steps.title: Install connector
steps.description: Use the universal installer from the Connect section on mmir.ai. It detects Mac, Windows, Linux/VM, Raspberry Pi/Linux ARM or Android client mode, reads the release manifest, and never promotes a Mac DMG until a real release artifact is published.

steps.title: Run local node on Mac, Windows or Linux
steps.description: Mac, Windows and Linux installers create the local API on 127.0.0.1:3000, connect to Ollama on the same machine, pull a starter model and keep the connector local by default.

steps.title: Use phone or tablet as client
steps.description: Android, iPhone and iPad use mmir.ai as clients connected to a Mac, Windows, Linux, Raspberry Pi/Linux ARM or VM node. Native on-device mobile model hosting is a separate app/runtime track and is not claimed as live.

steps.title: Run Raspberry Pi or Linux ARM node
steps.description: Use 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS or another arm64 Linux device with the Linux installer. MMIR marks it as an edge node, recommends a smaller starter model and keeps the connector bound to 127.0.0.1 by default.

steps.title: Detect local models
steps.description: The connector discovers Ollama models and returns them through the MMIR /models contract with safe metadata and hardware guidance.

steps.title: Pair with MMIR.ai
steps.description: The frontend pairs with the local connector before model/chat control. It stores only the local connector URL, session token and safe profile metadata.

steps.title: Chat safely
steps.description: MMIR routes chat requests through /chat/completions on 127.0.0.1:3000. Raw Ollama port 11434 should not be exposed publicly.

steps.title: Optional local tunnel
steps.description: The local connector can report tunnel status and request an opt-in TryCloudflare tunnel when the local node is started with MMIR_ENABLE_TUNNEL_CONTROL=true and cloudflared is installed. Tunnel control stays disabled by default.

security: No secrets in GitHub Pages frontend
Local connector requires pairing before model and chat routes
Raspberry Pi and edge nodes should pair locally or use an explicit secure tunnel/control-plane path for cross-device access
Use /tunnels/status and opt-in /tunnels/trycloudflare/start for temporary tunnel testing
Android is client mode until native APK/runtime security is designed
Allow users to disconnect and delete local profiles
